# TurfsyOTPs

> Developer-first OTP (One-Time Password) and transactional messaging REST API provider in India.

## Core Value Proposition
- High-throughput telecom gateway connectivity in India.
- Transparent pay-as-you-go wallet billing via Razorpay with zero monthly subscriptions.
- Automatic failure reversals: failed carrier deliveries are refunded to user wallet immediately.
- Average internal dispatch latency under 150ms.
- SHA-256 cryptographic API key hashing with zero plaintext secret retention.

## Technical Specifications
- Base URL: https://apinexusotp.vercel.app/api/v1
- Endpoint: POST /otp/send
- Auth: Bearer sk_live_...
- Payload: {"phone": "9876543210", "otp": "482910"}
- Response: {"success": true, "message": "OTP request accepted", "transaction_id": "TXN_...", "latency_ms": 142}

## Pricing
- Wallet-based deduction with dynamic tiered rates.
- No setup fees, no monthly software minimums.
